_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code settings. Commit this file to git so the team shares the same hook set. Per-user overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). NOTE: agents/skills/commands/memory need no keys here — Claude Code discovers .claude/agents/, .claude/skills/, .claude/commands/ and CLAUDE.md by fixed convention; the schema this file pins has no such keys, and shipping invalid keys is the dead-config anti-pattern the opencode adapter documents.
_hooks_comment: UserPromptSubmit runs route-hook.py on every prompt and injects its output (hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext) so the route-first step happens deterministically. Both Claude Code AND VS Code Copilot (Agent Hooks, Preview) read this .claude/settings.json hooks block. Path: Claude Code sets $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR to the repo root even when the session cwd is a subdirectory, so use it; Copilot falls back to $PWD (its hook cwd is the workspace root). Trailing '|| true' makes it FAIL-OPEN — a hook must never block a prompt.
_bound_hook_comment: PreToolUse runs bound-hook.py before every Bash call and refuses (exit 2) a blocking-prone command — service control, process signalling, package managers, installers, builds, log followers — that carries neither an explicit bound nor a detached launch. NOTE the missing '|| true': this hook is a GUARD, not a context injector, and a guard that cannot block is not a guard, so it is deliberately NOT fail-open. The asymmetry is paid for inside the script: it exits 0 or 2 and nothing else, every failure path (not Bash, no command, unparseable stdin, internal exception) exits 0 with one line on stderr, so a bug in the guard degrades to no guard and can never brick a session by blocking everything.
_status_hook_comment: SessionStart runs status-hook.py ONCE per session and injects `status-register.py --summary` (open / hotfix / deferred counts and the oldest items) so lifecycle debt is in front of the model before it plans. Not per prompt: the register is a frontmatter scan, and a session sees it once. Fail-open like route-hook: '|| true'.
